text:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT: spike in 5xx + 429s at /v1/generate (gateway). 5m window: 5xx=12%, 429=18%. Paging @maria (oncall) @jon (sre) @alice (eng-runtime). Suggested runbook: quota/rate-limit cascade check.

maria (oncall): seeing it in console too. traces show a lot of gateway timeouts and 502s from auth-proxy. starting triage.

jon (sre): looking at rate-limit-metrics -> sudden global quota enforcement event at 10:31Z. A config push to quota-service seems to have applied a stricter policy across routes.

alice (eng-runtime): I saw a deploy earlier with PR#5120 (quota default change). deploy-bot confirmed rollout at 10:28Z.

deploy-bot: Deployment PR#5120 merged by @alice. rollout: canary -> 100% complete at 10:29Z.

maria (oncall): ok, if quota misapply caused cascade, customers hitting limits will cause 429s which backpressure proxies and produce 5xx downstream. We should open a mitigation window.

jon (sre): immediate mitigations: 1) add temporary override to quota-service to restore old defaults 2) enable model fallback for critical customers 3) route traffic away from affected gateway region if possible. I'll try override now.

jon (sre): running override command --
```
# on quota-service admin
POST /admin/overrides HTTP/1.1
Host: quota-admin.internal
Content-Type: application/json
{"scope":"global","quota_factor":5, "reason":"emergency override - cascade mitigation"}
```

infra-bot: override accepted, new effective quota_factor=5 applied at 10:36Z, TTL=30m.

maria (oncall): watching error rates... 2m later: 5xx down to 6%, 429 down to 7%. Progress.

alice (eng-runtime): we should still reduce pressure on auth-proxy. I'll enable short-circuiting for non-critical telemetry to drop load and enable prefix caching for repeated sessions.

sophie (support): got inbound from two enterprise customers reporting timeouts. Communicated we have an active incident and mitigation steps in progress. Will send an interim status in 15m.

kai (product): need customer impact summary for legal/CS. Which customers hit 5xx vs 429s? can we surface top affected tenants?

jon (sre): pulling top tenants now. command: `SELECT tenant_id, count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE path='/v1/generate' AND status>=500 GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;`

jon (sre): top affected tenants: tenant_42, tenant_88, tenant_11. Noting tenant_42 had retries that amplified load.

maria (oncall): mitigation checklist update: override applied, fallback model enabled, telemetry throttled. Next: rollback PR#5120 then verify canary safety. alice, can you coordinate rollback?

alice (eng-runtime): starting rollback of PR#5120 -> new revert PR created: PR#5134. Kicking canary rollback.

deploy-bot: Revert PR#5134 submitted by @alice. Canary rollback started at 10:42Z.

maria (oncall): error rates trending down: 5xx=3%, 429=2% after rollback progressing. Good.

jon (sre): root cause summary so far: a config change to quota defaults reduced global effective quotas; quota-service evaluated policy across routes causing synchronous 429s which cascaded into gateway timeouts (proxy retries) and 5xx. Amplified by clients retrying and an auth-proxy bottleneck.

maria (oncall): action items for next 24h: 1) revert PR fully and add stronger rollout guard + automated smoke test 2) add threshold-based auto-rollback for quota-service changes 3) improve tenant-level rate-limiting isolation 4) postmortem. I'll create the ticket.

alice (eng-runtime): will add rollout smoke test (simple generate request + quorum check) before config changes go to 100%. Also will add a canary throttle so global changes don't apply to >10% traffic initially.

jon (sre): recommend we add a circuit-breaker at auth-proxy to prevent 429 spikes from creating proxy queueing. Raising infra task.

sophie (support): posting interim status to customers now: "We experienced elevated error rates at 10:30Z due to a quota configuration change. We've applied emergency overrides and rolled back the change; services are recovering. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem."

kai (product): thanks team. For the postmortem please include customer impact table, timeline, and mitigations. Also highlight recommended SLAs for emergency overrides.

maria (oncall): handing off to next on-call for monitoring and postmortem follow-up: @jon you'll own SRE follow-ups, @alice will own revert + rollout tests, @sophie will own customer comms, @kai will own stakeholder summary. Handoff at 11:15Z.

jon (sre): ack. I'll keep the dashboard pinned and notify when all follow-ups are done.

maria (oncall): incident resolved -> moving to monitoring state. Closing pager. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded. Final snapshot at resolution: 5xx peak=12%, 429 peak=18%, duration ~45m. Primary cause: quota config misapply (PR#5120). Mitigations: emergency quota override, revert PR#5134, fallback model enabled, telemetry throttle. Follow-up owners assigned.

sophie (support): saving notes to incident channel and posting summary to customers.

alice (eng-runtime): will submit PR for rollout guard and smoke test today.

jon (sre): creating postmortem draft and linking metrics + traces. ETA 24h.

kai (product): adding postmortem review to Monday ops sync.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. Passing to oncall-next for watch.

--- HANDOFF NOTE ---
maria (oncall): Handoff summary (11:15Z): cause=quota default change PR#5120, mitigations=quota-override, revert PR#5134, fallback model enabled, customer impact=timeouts/429s for top tenants (tenant_42, 88, 11), status=recovering. Owners: SRE=jon, EngRuntime=alice, Support=sophie, Product=kai.

jon (sre): ack - I'll update the incident tracker with timeline and attach logs.

sophie (support): ack - will follow up with affected customers once postmortem is ready.

(END OF THREAD)
